take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: I have read the ledger, every commit of it.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Six hundred and thirty-eight commits on the branch. Five hundred and forty-one of them, eighty-five percent, by the agent.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Two hundred and ninety are snapshots, marked work in progress. A hundred and forty-nine of them in a single day.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Forty-one point eight hours of rendering are logged. Thirty-one thousand, eight hundred and ten frames drawn, and two thousand, five hundred and forty-eight reused after an interruption.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Every film, published and kept, was checked by its hash. Seventy of seventy match.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: One gap. The music under the scenes is credited only as Treblo. I found no maker, and no licence.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: And the first film about all this was a slide show.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Pictures of the work, and one voice over them.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: No slides. Make it a film. With bricks, and with us in it.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Quiet on the set. And... action.
